tools.name: find_video_tool
tools.description: Find the Veedio tool page that best fits a short-video idea (TikTok, Reels, YuTube Shorts). Returns one to three pages, each with a title, a one-line promise and a link. Use it when someone asks which tool or format to use for a video idea.

tools.name: short_video_outline
tools.description: Plan a short vertical video from an idea: a hook line, a 4–6 beat structure with time ranges, caption tips and a call to action, plus a link to the Veedio tool page that can make it. Deterministic and instant. Use it when someone wants to plan, outline or script a TikTok, Reel or Short.
